issues.detail: The Greek word 'παραδεισω' (paradeisō) refers to 'paradise' (heaven), but the Vietnamese translation uses 'vườn địa đàng' (Garden of Eden). While 'paradise' is often associated with a garden, in New Testament theology, 'paradise' specifically denotes the dwelling place of the righteous after death, whereas 'vườn địa đàng' specifically refers to the earthly Garden of Eden.
